input.command:
git add server/src/routes/issues.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(server): pass resolved issue.id to downstream calls in issue routes

11 handlers in server/src/routes/issues.ts were resolving the issue via
svc.getById(id) (which accepts both UUIDs and human keys like \"ALM-1\")
and then passing the *raw* id to downstream services that expect a UUID.
When the UI hit any of these endpoints with a human key, Postgres threw
\"invalid input syntax for type uuid: ALM-1\" and the request 500'd.

Fixed handlers (use issue.id / existing.id instead of raw param):

  GET    /api/issues/:id/comments           — listIssueComments
  GET    /api/issues/:id/interactions       — listIssueInteractions
  GET    /api/issues/:id/attachments        — listAttachments
  GET    /api/issues/:id/feedback-votes     — getFeedbackVotes
  POST   /api/issues/:id/feedback-votes     — saveFeedbackVote
  GET    /api/issues/:id/approvals          — listIssueApprovals
  POST   /api/issues/:id/approvals          — linkIssueApproval (2 calls)
  DELETE /api/issues/:id/approvals/:approvalId — unlinkIssueApproval
  POST   /api/issues/:id/checkout           — checkoutIssue
  POST   /api/issues/:id/release            — releaseIssue
  POST   /api/issues/:id/admin-force-release — adminForceRelease

Bug applies equally on Node and CF deployments; surfaces more on CF
because the worker's logs are more visible.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
